reviews.text: Great lessons videos take forever to load. The lessons are really good when they actually load. Most of the time they don’t and it stalls momentum.

Musora is the best. I am only 11 years old and I love this app. I’ve been playing drums for two years and this is the best drumming app I have ever used. Anyone who wants to learn to play drums should definitely use this app and will definitely become a better drummer in no time.

Do yourself a huge favor and check this teaching app out!. After many years, I decided to return to playing piano. I researched many piano teaching apps, and for me, Musora really stood out from the crowd.
Musora offers four high quality teaching apps for the price of one, not just piano.
You are led by talented friendly folks who enjoy teaching and want you to succeed.
Do some research and I think you might agree with me. There is a free trial that will give a good overview of what is available in Musora.

Great help learning the drums!. Musora is genuinely a great tool. I’m a student with lots of ambitions besides learning how to play music, and this has helped me soooo much. The Musora Drumeo method has made things so much easier when learning how to play the drums, and not nearly as frustrating as other ways of learning. The lessons are quick, so it’s a nice rush dopamine and self accomplishment when you finish one, as well as easy to fit into a tight schedule. Everything is clearly explained, and there are seemingly infinite resources in Musora/Drumeo, like forums to chat with other drummers and ask for tips. I loooove Musora.
Good app. Great app, but the interface could be significantly less confusing.

Songs songs songs. Pianote user over two years ..prepped me to try playing songs, the new focus on playing songs works for me to take my piano where Captain Kirk dares to go? The revised app has songs now and the assignments work most of the time. Thanks for a great service
Good app. This app is great for people trying to learn guitar or even people who already know how to play

App is Abysmal. I’ve been using the app for like 2 years. The newest update is the worst ever. The app is practically unusable now. Lessons are generally fine but the app is a headache EVERY single time I try to use it.

Drumeo Rocks!. I’ve learned more from Drumeo than I ever could have without it.
Everything from technique
And basic skills to more advanced concepts and a wide variety of styles.
A big part of Drumeo for me is learning about hundreds of amazing drummers from the last hundred years to today, their histories, styles, and then getting to learn from them. It’s incredible. I even tell non-drummers to check it out because it’s so much fun.

A little buggy. I just signed up a couple of weeks ago for the drum and piano lessons. Both are GREAT and I highly recommend them. I look forward to completing the daily lessons. My only complaint is that the app doesn’t always open up and sometimes takes a few tries before it loads. Once it loads, however, it works perfectly fine. (Sidenote: Lisa Witt is awesome!)

Good lessons, terrible app. This review is about the app and not the lessons themselves. I used drumeo daily and find it very helpful, but the app experience is absolutely unacceptable. 

Update: they made the app worse. They addressed most of the issues below, but broke the rest of the user experience. It is now difficult or impossible to find relevant lessons, they made video playback speed less fine tuned (jumps of .5x instead of .25x), practice resources/practice files attached to lessons are… gone? The updated drumeo learning method doesn’t even teach beginners how to hold sticks? 
So if you’re trying to learn drums and have no attention span, this update is for you. 

Old review:
Videos are constantly missing from recent lessons, it’s a piecemeal of things you’ve watched in the past few days rather than an actual history. Too many things you click on in the app take you to the browser version instead, including songs which are no longer no longer supported in the app (browser only). The app is absolutely frustrating and ruins what is otherwise a good learning experience. 

My biggest grievance is when I hit “Continue” to view challenges I was working on yesterday, they are completely absent from my history. I have to go searching for them to continue where I left off. This happens on the 30 day challenge when I’ve already completely numerous days of them. They just vanish from the history. 

The app is basically a terrible browser experience, it would almost be better to not have an app. 

The songs (when they were available in the app and now still in the browser) have some nice features as far as slowing down, highlighting notes etc, but it doesn’t remember your settings so if you have a preference for how to display, you have to reset it for every single song, every single time. 

The lessons themselves are good, and there are lots of them. All that’s missing is a consistent app experience for them.

Did not get content I paid for. I paid for a subscription and I never got access to the content. I reached out to customer service 5 different times, got 1 response, and no resolution. $240 for literally nothing. 10/10 do not recommend.
App rarely works. This was my go to app to learn drums but since they’ve updated, it’s worked 2 times over the last 2 months.

new app is terrible. Constantly complains no internet connection and i haveto close and open. Lessons are also messily organized. All the previous course that i started automatically dissappeared. its lot more buggy than i thought
Drumeo. Soooo upset that they removed the XP and tier system. It made playing and learning so much more enjoyable and created a sense of progress.

No Method. I signed up hoping for this great method. Looked so promising. However, they changed their site the day I signed up a few weeks ago and only 3 beginner courses are included in their “methods”.

There is no longer a guided legacy learning piano course as they rebuild their site for who knows how long. 

I have reached out to them by multiple phone calls, email, community forum and receive no replies except from a student who has no clue about the app or site. The community moderator was nice but ineffective and never ended up helping after multiple texts.

Very disappointed with the communication and misleading promise of a guided methodology. What a colossal waste of time as they never get back to you. And charge you more than most learning sites.

I suggest staying away at least until they get their act together.
Not stable. Constantly locks up starting it or clicking on a push notification
Fantastic. The app teaches you to read drum music subconsciously. It’s amazing. Highly recommended.

What happened? 1 STAR ONLY!!!!. I want to start this off by saying I NEVER review apps. This is the first review ever. I literally just did a free trial of drumeo. Loved it. Perfect for me as I just got an e-kit and haven’t played drums since college. After my payment went through, the app updated and I am completely lost. I loved how easy it was to get around in the app before. No idea why they changed the format but I wish they would undo it. Where is the drumeo method? Why are rudiments not listed as a category anymore? A year subscription isn’t cheap. Kinda feel that you have an obligation to keep a consistent product if you are asking people to pay that price. Really disappointed.

New Version is an Abomination. Loved this program and the system until about 48 hours ago. They pushed a “updated” version that is actually a downgrade and have alienated a majority of loyal students to the method. This is no longer a quality experience and you will find it a waist of valuable practice time. 

Sad story of a once great company.

Feb. 2025 update. This update has made the app borderline unusable. The metronomes no longer work in the play alongs and often the music will drop from play alongs as well. The programs no longer keep your progress on the video you were on and instead start the entire playlist over. These changes are terrible.
New app update. Before the update, when I was on Jordan ‘s course and doing the assignments, when I was completed with the assignment, it would mark as completed. Now I cannot see that
Terrible update. New update ruined the app. It is literally unusable.

Buggy. I enjoy the drum lessons, but the app is feeling buggy. I’m using the app on an iPhone Pro Max with the latest version of iOS and attempting to AirPlay the video to my Apple TV and often the app lags in time where the video and the audio do not sync up correctly. Additionally when I try to x out of a video, the target disappears before I can even tap it and I can tap fast. I’m also having problems with the videos loading on occasion I’m using a eero network with business class Wi-Fi speed at a nearly 200 Mb download speed. And my cell signal when not on Wi-Fi is a 5G on Verizon. But some videos will stutter I’m wondering if this is a issue based on where the videos are stored and how they are loaded into the app because it doesn’t seem like it’s building much buffer for any network hiccups.

Great lessons terrible app. Update: I was told to email in after sending this feedback because they had some updates coming in. I did and my money was refunded and account shut down. How is this normal customer service? Here is my original review: These lessons are so valuable but navigating where you left off in the app is horrible. I am so utterly confused as to where I am in my learning journey. There is no reason why an app should be this unfriendly to the user. It’s the easiest part to get right.

Super Helpful. I have been using Musora for drums and guitar and it has helped me progress a ton. I’d say this is great software to start, learn the basics, and for practice. I don’t think it completely replaces an actual instructor as they can catch bad habits and weaknesses and develop specific plans to address these. But I’d say if you are picking up an instrument for a hobby, start here and if you love it then invest in weekly lessons to improve.
New app soon. Hopefully the new app fixes the video playback errors going forward 🙏

Finally. Trying to teach yourself how to play piano is not easy. It’s a slow process for me but I am beginning to understand some of the terminology. I will be stuck on arpeggios for a while until I’m comfortable. Lisa makes it very easy to understand arpeggios along with the fingering. I want to really be able to just play but this is like it was when I was studying electronics you have to start at the bottom and work your way up. Lisa makes that easy. Patience and practice. Thanks Lisa

Great app with issues. The most recent iPad update has caused a major issue for me. Practice sessions won’t load the videos, so I’m forced to do challenges and workouts without access to the sheet music.
The best app for musicians. If you want to invest in your musical career, this is the best place to start. The app works fantastic.

Great lessons, terrible app. The UX on the app is horrible, that being said, the lessons are awesome. I do recommend it.

You guys should hire a PM to work on the app, at least drumeo doesn’t work as it should.
Love drumeo , app needs work. Nothing has a picture or anything Wich makes it slower to navigate . But I do love drumeo

Learning Drums. I was stuck. Couldn’t seem to get traction and wasn’t sure how to proceed. Talked to a buddy he suggested Drummeo. So freakn glad I finally got this. Finally making headway and learning a ton. Can’t wait to try all of Musora. Just a wealth of musical knowledge. Don’t wait like I did. Get it and get going on your path to becoming a better musician.

Songs don’t work in app. Songs don’t work in app and some videos require you to go out of the app and view them in a browser like it’s 2005. I understand if there’s licensing issues but the content shouldn’t be built on songs that can be there one day and gone the next day. If they’re reading this and make changes I’d love to know. Just bought the one year subscription and wondering if I made a mistake with other apps like this out there.

Great lessons terrible app. As others have mentioned the lessons are great but they are really doing a disservice by this app. The navigation is confusing and generally poorly designed. Method, lessons, packs. Really hard to pick up where you left off. Recommendations on where to go next are poor and generally unhelpful despite being prominently displayed. You almost need a user forum to figure out the next content and how to dig for it.
Does not work well.. It is super glitchy, and weird, half the time the videos don’t work! Does not last as long as the subscription says.😩
Seriously? Have to pay just for try?. Trash bin.

Great lessons, bad app. The lessons are great! And there are so many of them! But the app needs an overhaul. It’s buggy, and can be hard to navigate and use. It has cleared my progress in challenges multiple times. Buttons don’t always do what they say they’re going to do. Songs aren’t available in app (which I assume is some limitation related to licensing), but they work fine in browser.
Musora is awesome. It’s so fun to practice tons of music and have great awesome coaches that are available for you
Great content. Buggy app. Crashes or locks up often on my m2 ipad pro.

So hard to cancel membership!!. Only time i’ve ever written a review and I guess it just got me at the wrong time but I am very frustrated. Canceling this membership shouldn’t be this hard! I still haven’t gotten to cancel it as I’m writing this.

Makes you want to quit. Nothing worse than being told you missed a lesson when you didn’t. The streak thingy is designed to shame you. Your app glitched at lesson 5 and no matter how many times I play it, it says I missed a lesson when I didn’t. Get rid of the shaming
App locks up to white screen. App locks up with white screen and cannot get back

App problem?. I am using this app to learn to play the drums via drumeo. For some reason, whenever I click on “complete” after a lesson, the screen goes black, and I have to restart the app to continue. Please fix this.

Crashing Issues. Review will promptly change to a 5 once the bug is addressed. Every time I complete a lesson the app goes a blank white screen instead of showing my exp and allowing me to progress. I then have to force close the app to have it resume functioning.

Used on an iPhone 15 with IOS 18.5
Online wins. Best way to practice, headphones and playing along. Kind of better than an in person teacher IMO
Very good app. This app is helping me learn how to play drums and piano, it is so helpful with all the courses you can enroll in and all the amazing instructors that help me.

eh. good lessons, but what happened to the huge library of songs you had? a bunch of my favorites got taken away and now i have way more limited choices. also you used to be able to play songs in the app. what happened there? it’s annoying to have to go to the browser every time i want to play a song.
Bug fixed. It seems the bug that was bothering me. The most has been fixed. Downloaded videos seem to work fine now online or off-line.

Song Transcriptions. The app was a SOLID 5 stars before just about every song I had on my practice playlist was wiped from the app and the website. I absolutely love everything drumeo has put together over the years and they are 100 percent worth the money I paid, but losing all of those songs completely shut down the momentum I had towards learning harder and harder songs and getting better as a drummer. I’ve reached out to the help desk and they’ve told me to wait and the songs will be back eventually. What pains me is knowing there’s a huge library of songs I want to learn that are fully transcribed by professionals locked away somewhere, while I continue to pay the same subscription price.
Wanted a free simple learning kit. I wanted to learn the drums but got on and immediately had to pay to use it. So annoying
Recent update. I can no longer use the app since the update this week. Therefore I am missing lessons!

Pay to use. I wanted to use a free app to learn drums looked for the app that chatgpt recommended me which is drumeo snd all i found was this app and drumeo kids (im not a five year old) but when i opened it up i got flash banged with a subscription and i need it just to use the app and not very fun.

My Access was reduced. I joined drumeo in 2022 and paid for the yearly membership at $200 a year which was great, lots of songs to play and plenty of lessons to improve my chops. I haven't played much recently but I like to dabble in guitar and piano as well. When I went to practice a song on the piano (pianote, which is included in my Musora lifetime membership), it asked me to upgrade my membership. I paid for a lifetime membership in 2024 and it cost me $1,200 which is a lot for me (and most other people I believe) and not even a year later my access to songs has been restricted since my lifetime membership doesn't count as a Musora+ subscription. It would be an additional $40 a year on top of the $1,200 I already paid. If I had known that I wouldn't have songs access less than a year after purchasing a "lifetime membership" I definitely would not have made the purchase. It feels like I was ripped off and I'll continue to use the app but they won't get another dime from me and I will not recommend the service to anyone I know. Don't give them any money, they can change up your access without warning. It's what they did it to me.

Musora. Hi 👋 everyone, drumeo is a great program. I’m really enjoying all the teachers and practice time. It’s easy to use. Fun to learn from the teachers, and there’s so much content available. This is an awesome way everyone can gain sufficient skills in the keyboard, guitar, singing, and drums. No matter your starting point. It’s all included. Don’t wait to get started! 
: )
Thieves. Extremely difficult to cancel subscription

Immensely helpful. The lessons are informative and entertaining. I’ve done piano, guitar, and voice. The ability to get professional feedback and guidance is amazing. Keeping a little practice journal and getting feedback from others feels less lonely. I recommend this app to anyone with a fledgling interest in music. It is a LOT of work to improve musical skills! Musora makes it enjoyable and something I look forward to every day.

content great … app does not work properly. been with app over a year. wish i had read these reviews. got misled by overall 4.8 rating.

the app freezes. practice feature jumps and freezes. constantly rebooting to get a lesson. no refunds … the support staff is ready not to help but apologize and blames my equipment that is 2024 new ipad and fiber high speed internet. great lessons poor app .. odd way to run a platform… the web version works perfectly…. but the app doesnt even have songs .. only on the web version … but cant play piano on a laptop. 

hope someone at Musora reads this. but looking at dates of app being poorly designed … i doubt it will ever be righted.

Great lesson but…... Really enjoy the lessons - top notch! However navigation and organization could be better. Please for all that is holy figure out how to not drain an entire iPad battery in three hours when I forget to close the app.
Great App. Love everything with Drumeo. Got me playing set for the first time ever after a ten year hiatus after 7 years of drum line in high school and college

Great Content - App needs work. This is a great learning tool that is structured and organized really well. The tech side can use some work though. App can be buggy with broken links, lag, and sometimes lessons crash and app needs to be restarted which can be very disruptive to the learning process. If they get that cleaned up this will be a tough platform to beat for music learning.

Drumeo is great. The app on the other hand…. Not so much. Please stop redirecting me from the browser, as the app isn’t nearly as user friendly and doesn’t even support song playback. I mostly use Musora/Drumeo to play along to songs (most of which have been removed, but that’s another story) and having to jump through hoops to just use the software I paid for is very annoying.

Good App but some issues. This app is amazing, and if your reading this and you haven’t already downloaded it you probably should, but there are some bugs, like some lessons freeze or the app signs me out, but other than a little bit of bugs it’s amazing 😁👍
Great WEBSITE Five stars for WEBSITE. The website is the best thing to happen in music. The only thing about the IOS is we can’t access the song library. Great WEBSITE.

Awesome. I am a drummer so I use the Drumeo part of Musora the most and it has really helped me. I drummed just a little bit before but I was just messing around most of the time. But once I got Musora I felt and definitely noticed that my drumming was getting better. I have had it for just a few months, but in that short time, I have definitely seen improvement in my drumming. I also play the guitar, so the guitareo part of it is also helpful. They also have songs you can learn and play along to with drum less tracks. Would definitely recommend this for anyone who is interested, trying to get better, pick it up again, and/or someone that has been doing it for a while, whether it’s singing (singeo), drumming (drumeo), guitar (guitareo), and/or piano (pianote).
Doesn’t work with AirPlay. Never works with AirPlay, no other apps experiencing this issue. Technical support phone number picks up and is muted, no audio once they answer. Videos often don’t load.

Meh. They don’t give you a refund, Forgot to cancel sub, requested a refund on the same day, got rejected twice. iOS app is useless, nothing is available and it directs you to web app. Great content tho.
Good. It’s very good for my kids learning music

Trash. This is the worst app I’ve used for learning piano. It’s basically a simplistic wrapper around a bunch of videos. The songs force you to open your browser. It won’t use the microphone to listen to your playing. Compared to Flowkey, Simply Piano, or endless others, this one is quite terrible. 

It’s sad, because I suspect the actual teachers behind it are better than the other apps, but honestly YouTube is better.
No music to learn. You only have like nirvana dongs not pop songs please fix this it’s false advertisement

I’ve learned so much!. This is a great tool for singers and musicians at the beginner, and intermediate level, but also be a tool for advanced students. There’s a method series for beginners and intermediate students that is fantastic, and there’s a ton of other content for any level like practice routines, special topics covered in detail and live classes… it’s a treasure trove. I’ve used it for vocal practice and it’s been an incredible resource to help me along my journey… from helping me find my voice to feeling more confident singing in a band. It’s been more helpful than in person voice lessons because it explains all the basics to help me build the foundation I need. Love it and can’t do without it…thanks to all the teachers and staff that make it possible.

Back in the Groove. Just wanted you to know how much I am enjoying this piano course. I am just amazed at how much I am learning through your Methods lessons in just a couple of weeks. Lisa, your teaching method is exactly what I needed. I took lessons in grade school and a few years ago briefly so I have a basic background, however, the way you organized the methods class builds on what I already know. I’ve got a ways to go, but I’m on my way! Yolanda M.
Unstable. The app regularly freezes and also fails to load the lesson. It also make my phone run hot and sometimes overheat.
Bait and Switch. Removed the song features drumeo had I want my money back this app is horrible now

Pianote. Pianote is a great way to begin the journey of learning piano! Lisa Witt is such a great teacher and is very encouraging. She has also many other teachers involved and a wide range of lessons for all levels. Highly recommended!
Used to be good. First they removed songs. Then they removed IOS support. Then they removed the ability to search for newly added songs.

Life never means nothing. Have been a member for years including paying for the lifetime membership. Now they are taking things away or wanting to charge again with Musora+ or something. It is clear from reading all these reviews I’m not the only one who feels betrayed. If you agree to offer something (especially called lifetime) and we agree and then pay for it, how can you just take it away?!!

Hi Drumeo. Hi guys, some of the drums lessons are not available anymore I was practicing the fatback by Dennis chambers I wanted to continue practicing so sad it’s not available some other Lessons too. could you please fix it 🙏

Lost a ton. This was by far my favorite app of all my apps until this most recent update converted Drumeo into Musora. Now Drumeo has no songs to pull up in the app, only online, the online page won't let you shrink the size of the YouTube video so the notes are nearly impossible to read additionally half the time it won't even load the sheet music making the whole thing pretty worthless. I love this app, and it's expensive so I'd really love it if it just went back to working again. Also they keep taking tracks off the app/site which is annoying as well.

Terrible support - don’t subscribe. I subscribed for several months for Pianote.
They decided to merge the app, and since then I am not able to access my account.

Tried to solve the issue through:
- chat (just a chatbot)
- email (nobody returned)
- phone (nobody talked to me)
- phone callback (useless)

I ended cancelling my subscription.

Missing songs.. I’ve used this app for a few years now. I love it and have grown so much in drumming. I have the subscription but many songs that I have previously played are no longer on the app. A lot of my favorite songs to play have disappeared. It’s definitely not as fun anymore. I don’t know if it has to do with copyright but it’s sad. I can’t find any Bruno Mars or Twenty One Pilots.

Older drummer. I’m into my 3rd year with Drumeo. As someone over 70 The mentors & support are 2nd to none. Reading drum music is like learning a new language. Active listening works best for me. I am a product of the 60’s and 70’s , Rock N Roll & Doo Wop music era. 
Thank you Jared, K-Rad, Domino and the Mods who are front line…
Songs. The removal of songs from iOS is a dealbreaker for me. Even if you use Safari, they removed 1/2 the songs I enjoy playing.
Songs Removed With Zero Notice. More than half of the transcribed songs were removed with ZERO notice. Working on learning a song? NOPE! It was removed. No trust in this company whatsoever.

AMAZING service and Instructors. GARBAGE app.. I’m so torn here because everything BUT the app is amazing.

There was no easy way to find the starting point for a beginner. There should just be playlists made that say “START HERE” 

But the biggest gripe I have is the inconsistency with how videos load. Some youtube. Some private server. Sometimes the app will glitch out of full screen video and not let me get back. And having youtube ads for COMPLETELY unrelated videos is nonsense. Transfer everything to a private server so the viewing experience remains consistent and distraction free. I’m seeing all kinda of political videos plastered on my screen when I just wanna automatically go to the next lesson.
VIDEOS WONT LOAD. Very disappointing. The videos won’t load half the time on this app.

Great Content, Lackluster App. First off, this review is not about the content of the application or Musora as a product itself. The lessons are phenomenal and created by very talented instructors.

However, the app is a bit lackluster. I don’t use anything mounted to my drum kit and prefer to play things on my Apple TV, however I am unable to actually AirPlay any video content to the TV. Instead, I primarily find myself using the website so I can actually watch the videos the way I like. However, the musical loops in the Drumeo section are pretty unusable on mobile web and then I have to fall back to the app, and need to constantly switch inputs on my ekit’s Bluetooth input when playing along to lessons. It would would also be great to see this as an Apple TV app, but unfortunately they seemingly chose React Native as their development stack, so they would have to rebuild everyone to make an Apple TV app. I’m assuming this is also why I’m unable to AirPlay to anything through the app because they use the Google chromecast SDK, which does not support AirPlay. Overall, this app is kind of a bummer.

Too Pricey. Drumeo by far makes the and most accurate best drum tabs, but the only way to access them is too pay for a full Musora membership. You should be able to select what you want to pay for rather than paying $240 a year for all of them. I would use this app a lot more if I only had to pay for Drumeo.
Does not work anymore. When you first download the app it asks you what membership you want but pressing on the button does nothing and keeps you on that screen
Same bugs even after every update. Drumeo is a great service but there’s so many bugs that can be annoying (lots of screen freezing) and you just have to restart the app to fix.

Incredible.. I have found this site to be just Awesome. Great coaches, Great courses, from working on the full kit to rudiments on the practice pad, to incorporating rudiments into fills on the kit. The forums are an awesome way to gather knowledge from other drummers with more experience, great people who are more then interested in helping and encouraging you. 30 Day drummer and 30 day chops have been just an eye opener for me. Chops has made me completely focused on my fills. 30 day drummer is a great foundation and I love messing around with implementing rudimental fills in Domino’s beats. 30 day independence is another Homerun… helping me with my focus which helping to learn drum parts to actual songs not just playing along with them in time. I retire from the carpenters union and plan on taking a full time position behind my kit working with Drumeo. Thanks for the endless amount of content, and the entertainment provided by the Drum Department. Great work!! Keep it up. Joe Christian. JC3344
Killing it!!!. You guys are doing an awesome job!! Feels like I have 50 personal drum instructors. Toughest part of my day is figuring what do I want to work on next. lol. Keep up the great work.

Confusing App for this New Drummer. I bought the new Alesis Nitro Max knowing it came with the Drumeo app. It had great reviews and i was excited, but then i logged in.

There is no course path… you have to figure it out yourself. There is literally a 7 lesson app just to learn how to use the app. The beginning drum courses also start with boring stuff, like how to listen for drums in existing songs. After you get a kit the last thing you want to do is listen to other people play, you want to play yourself…

Tl,dr, I expected there to be a laid out course path for beginners, and now its looking like YouTube is the better option for beginner video courses.

Maybe the app is better for more experienced drummers, but for this beginner I was disappointed and glad the trial was free from Alesis.

Updatw causing videos to not sync up with audio. The new update that came out today, it’s not allowing videos to sync up with the audio. I’ve closed the app down restart of the phone, and still the same issue.

Great learning app. I was scared when I bought my electric drum set, I felt like I never had good rhythm my whole life & wasn’t sure if I could catch on, but thanks to Drumeo, I feel like i’m doing good for having never playing drums before. I love the lessons & that I can pause, rewind, slow them down until i’m more comfortable with what i’m doing. 
The 30 day drummer course is a lot of fun & it’s only about 10 minutes a day. 
The community on the app is really encouraging & helpful too!

Best music instruction App/Service I have ever used. The high quality video lessons are amazing, and they come with a solid set of practice material. Then I find these songs I can play along to, and they give me the music for all of them, some of them I can play with special “backing” like drumless tracks and that’s just great. Lots of instructors/professionals here and I love all this content!

Where have you been all my life. After taking about a 20 year break from playing drums I started playing again. Got my pad out and started working on my rudiments. As I got back on the kit, I found myself struggling in certain areas. I decided to look into Drumeo. I wish this tool was available 30 years ago. It has been extremely helpful in in areas that I have struggled with. Also learning new genres. Search for a topic and there it is. I just started incorporating some metal into my playing. Aaron Edgar has been extremely helpful. I like the way he breaks it down. I love Drumeo. Happy to be part of the community! Highly recommended for any level.

Incredible!!!. The drums have always been the instrument I was most curious about. Drumeo has made it possible for people to learn it at their own rate, with clear and simple instruction. I am totally satisfied and have enjoyed my whole experience!
